sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
turns: So, what kind of lawn and garden work do you do?
I don't really do much gardening to be honest. I work as a pharmacist and it takes up most of my time. But I do try to keep my lawn neat and tidy, mostly by mowing it regularly.

I see. I actually really enjoy gardening and I'm a grocery store manager, so I don't have as much time for it as I would like. But I make sure to take care of my plants and flowers whenever I can. I also like to do some landscaping and plant new things every once in a while.
That sounds great! I'm a bit envious of your gardening skills. I wish I had more time to do it myself. What kind of plants and flowers do you like to grow?
